name: Yandere Lily Holic -Sacchan no Aijou Hyougen-
original_name: ヤンデレリリィホリック-さっちゃんの愛情表現-
source:
A yandere yuri adventure game featuring girls with twisted desires
Mikagami Sachi, an honor student, has a certain secret. 
She's in a romantic relationship with her classmate and friend since junior high, Kisaragi Hotaru. 
However, it's not just any relationship; 
they have a distorted bond where Sachi expresses her "love expressions" in twisted ways towards Hotaru. 
While portraying herself as an honor student, Sachi continues to vent her dark desires on Hotaru in secret.
But one day, her school life starts to fall apart.

[From [url=https://akatsukimeu.itch.io/202210a-sacchan]itch.io[/url]]

Title changed from さっちゃんの愛情表現 in November 2023.
translation:
一款yandere yuri冒险游戏，主角是有着扭曲欲望的女孩
优等生三镜幸有一个秘密。
她与初中时的同学兼好友——如月萤保持着恋爱关系。
然而，这不仅仅是任何关系；
他们之间的关系是扭曲的，幸以扭曲的方式向萤表达了她的“爱的表达”。
幸一边把自己描绘成一名优等生，一边继续暗中向萤发泄自己的阴暗欲望。
但有一天，她的学校生活开始崩溃。

[来自[url=https://akatsukimeu.itch.io/202210a-sacchan]itch.io[/url]]

标题从2023年11月的“さっちゃんの爱情表现”变更为“さっちゃんの爱情表现”。
